record.one_liner: An API to access and manage Google Ads accounts, campaigns, reporting, and mutations using OAuth 2.0.
record.blocker: Requires a developer token and OAuth 2.0 configuration, but exact tier-based access requirements (test vs ship) are not fully detailed in the sources.
